{{Short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2021–22 |team=NC State Wolfpack |sport=Basketball |image=North Carolina State University Athletic logo.svg |image_size=100 |conference=Atlantic Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=ACC |record= 11–21 |conf_record= 4–16 |APRank= |CoachRank= |head_coach=[[Kevin Keatts]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1=[[James Johnson (basketball, born 1971)|James Johnson]] |asst_coach2=Roy Roberson |asst_coach3=Mike Summey |stadium=[[PNC Arena]] |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina State University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wolfpack were led by fifth-year head coach [[Kevin Keatts]] and played their home games at [[PNC Arena]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). The Wolfpack finished the season 11–21 overall and 4–16 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in fifteenth place. As the fifteenth seed in the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to [[2021–22 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the first round. They were not invited to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|Wolfpack]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 14–11, 9–8 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in ninth place. In the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the first round.{{Cite web |last=McAllister |first=Mike |date=2021-03-10 |title=Five Takeaways from Syracuse's ACC Tournament Win Over NC State |url=https://www.si.com/college/syracuse/basketball/five-takeaways-syracuse-beats-nc-state-acc-tournament |access-date=2021-09-23 |website=Sports Illustrated }} They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as the third seed in the [[2020–21 Colorado State Rams men's basketball team|Colorado State]] bracket.{{Cite web |last=Henderson |first=James |date=2019-03-19 |title=NIT bid can pay off for the 'Pack |url=https://www.wralsportsfan.com/nit-bid-can-pay-off-for-the-pack/18270596/ |access-date=2021-09-23 |website=WRALSportsFan.com }} The Wolfpack defeated [[2020–21 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]] in the first round{{Cite web|title=NC State vs. Davidson - Game Recap - March 18, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311775|access-date=2021-09-23|website=ESPN.com}} before losing to Colorado State in the quarterfinals.{{Cite web|title=NC State vs. Colorado State - Game Recap - March 25, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311784|access-date=2021-09-23|website=ESPN.com}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {|class="wikitable sortable" border="1" style="text-align: center;" |+ style="{{CollegePrimaryStyle|NC State Wolfpack|color=white|border=no}}" | Departures |- align=center {{CollegeSecondaryHeader|team=NC State Wolfpack| Name| Number| Pos.| Height| Weight| Year| Hometown|class8=unsortable| Reason for departure}} |- | [[D.
